mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthened economic demand, boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, S&P 500 forward returns decline over the next 20 trading days due to increased borrowing costs.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 1.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 4.5% and PAYEMS increases by 200k+ in a month, signaling a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns rise over the next 5 trading days due to increased consumer confidence.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to enhanced economic output.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in months with positive INDPRO growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds $450k, signaling strong retail sales, and HOUST is above 1100, indicating a robust housing market, S&P 500 forward returns increase over the next 60 trading days due to broadened economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in CPIAUCSL over two consecutive months, signaling easing inflationary pressures, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as interest rate expectations adjust.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of instances with 2-month CPIAUCSL declines, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the current UNRATE level, as a standalone indicator of labor market health, positively correlates with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, reflecting the influence of employment on economic growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 3-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns do not significantly correlate with UNRATE levels (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 growth exceeds 3% YoY and PAYEMS increases by 150k+ in the same quarter, signaling synchronized demand and labor strength, S&P 500 forward returns rise over the next 60 trading days due to amplified economic growth.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY growth > 3% and PAYEMS increase > 150k
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of triggered quarters, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.
